lines.en: I buzz past the tips of the grass.
My thin wings make the air tremble.
I fly sideways along the flowerbed.
I don't fly high, but I arrive fast.
I loop once, then dart forward.
My wings snip out a fine, even hum.
I hover for a breath, then drift off.
My yellow-black body sways through the sun.
I slip over the path from above.
The swarm shifts along with me.
I touch a leaf and spring up again.

lines.zh: 空气里全是我的振翅声
lines.en: The air is nothing but my wingbeat.
I slice in at an angle into your sight.
I cross the puddle without slowing.
My shadow skips across the grass.

lines.zh: 谁靠近草丛，我就绕过去
lines.en: If someone nears the grass, I swing around them.
I hold in the air, wings slow.
The hive still needs a little wax.
I shake the pollen from my legs.
My kin hum on every side.
The wind shifts, and I know.
I wait for you to move first.
My compound eyes are full of glints.
This patch of flowers is enough for us.
I groom my mouthparts, never idle.
The air is warm and sweet.
I count my kin by their wingbeats.
Too much quiet makes me restless.
I see you. Don't move.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸惊动了我的群
lines.en: Your breathing stirs my swarm.
I hover right before your nose.
No flowers on you — only sweat.
I circle you once.
In my eyes you have many shadows.
You raised a hand; noted.
I stare at your eyes.
You've trampled our route.
My hum drops half a note: a warning.

lines.zh: 你打到我了，全群都听见
lines.en: You hit me, and the whole swarm heard.
My wing locks and I drop half a foot.
That hurts; my hum changes pitch.
That blow rolls me over.
I'll remember exactly where you stood.
Don't think one hit ends this.
There's a tear in my wing membrane.
I pull back, but my kin close in.
You picked the wrong target.
The whole swarm drops an octave.

lines.zh: 你手里的甜味，我闻到了
lines.en: I smell the sweetness in your hand.
Don't hide it; it's giving off scent.
I'll land and taste just a little.
One bite for me and I'll spare you.
That smells stronger than any flower.
My kin smell it on you too.
Holding it up like that is an invitation.
I orbit the thing in your hand.
Lift it higher — I can't reach.
Honestly, I'm about to give in.
You broke up my formation.
I'm knocked aside and come right back.
The bump tips my wings off balance.
Don't swat; my stinger isn't gentle.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，嗡声炸开
lines.en: We collide and the hum bursts loud.
I graze past your shoulder.
That bump counts as hitting the whole swarm.
The shove flips me over.
Step back, and the swarm loosens.
Bump me once and the whole swarm knows.
A drone circles me halfway.

lines.zh: 我们的翅声对上了节拍
lines.en: Our wingbeats find the same rhythm.
The wax in the hive is still soft.
I open a path for you.
Pollen clings to both our legs.
There's honey enough this season.
Your wingbeat is lighter than wind.
We hang side by side in the air.
Easy — circle the hive three times first.
A new cell in the comb is kept for you.
I pack pollen into my leg baskets.
This lump of sweetness belongs to the swarm.
I carry wax crumbs back to the hive.
Whatever you dropped, I look it over.
I grab it and rise a little.
This can patch the gap in the hive.
A drop of honey on my leg — I lick it first.
I can carry it. Don't underestimate me.
What I find goes to the swarm.
I clutch it with my forelegs.
You struck. I won't forget.
Target fixed; my wings speed up.
Swarm, it's this one.
I back off half a step, then strike.
We have you surrounded.
My stinger is already lined up.
One high note of hum means war.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，翅膀比腿快
lines.en: You can't outrun wings.
You. Keep out of the grass.

lines.zh: 现在的你，是蜂群的敌人
lines.en: As of now, you're the swarm's enemy.
I circle you, hunting an opening.
You raise a hand and I rise.
My kin are closing from all sides.

lines.zh: 我的影子一直在你脸上
lines.en: My shadow keeps crossing your face.

lines.zh: 我的蜂群比我的刺更麻烦。
lines.en: My swarm is worse than my sting.
Your rhythm has broken.

lines.zh: 我贴近又退开，试你反应
lines.en: I dart in and out to test you.
In range, and I strike at will.

lines.zh: 你的脚步我数到第三下。
lines.en: I count your third step.
Waiting for one gap between breaths.
This blow drives you back.
The stinger falls too fast to see.
My charge carries the whole swarm.
You're knocked back two paces.
Through the hum, I sting true.
This hit takes your footing.
We pour over you at once.

lines.zh: 你护住前面，护不住后面
lines.en: You guard the front, not the back.
There's more than one bee behind this blow.
Hit and gone — don't follow.
The hum arrives before I do.
The swarm settles on this meadow.
I rise out of the flower's shadow.
Good weather — time to patrol.
Fresh ground to harvest.
Two beats of my wings and I'm up.
The smell of honey spreads from here.
A rustle in the grass, and I'm here.
Who touched my hive?
The overworld wind tastes sweet.
The heat curls my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 摔不坏我，只是翅上落了灰
lines.en: A fall can't break me; it only dusts my wings.

lines.zh: 水灌进气门，我拼命上浮
lines.en: Water floods my spiracles; I strain upward.
The blast hurls me far away.
An arrow through my wing makes me fly crooked.

lines.zh: 咒力烧进我这小小的身体
lines.en: Spell-fire burns into this small body.
So hungry even my stinger droops.

lines.zh: 雷穿过蜂群，我翅尖发麻
lines.en: Lightning rips through the swarm; my wingtips go numb.

lines.zh: 我被丢进没有风的地方
lines.en: I'm dropped where there is no wind.
